summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 3, 2026, reporting assay results for four directional diamond drill holes and a mother hole at the Ramp Zone of the Apollo deposit, Guayabales Project, Caldas, Colombia. Hole APC174-D4 returned 154.30 m @ 12.66 g/t AuEq from 1,208 m below surface, including 30.45 m @ 39.01 g/t AuEq, the broadest high-grade Ramp intercept to date; grades locally exceeded the current Mineral Resource block estimates. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is involved; a roughly 3-km underground exploration adit is expected to begin construction this month. Watch pending assays and adit progress.
